mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM sales_out WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 'approved') as todaySalesAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_in WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 'approved') as todayPurchaseAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_income WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 'approved') as todayReceiveAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_expense WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 'approved') as todayPaymentAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM sales_out WHERE DATE(create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND status = 'approved') as monthSalesAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_in WHERE DATE(create_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND status = 'approved') as monthPurchaseAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory) as totalInventoryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity <= min_quantity) as warningInventoryCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 'pending') as pendingPurchaseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE status = 'pending') as pendingSalesCount

SELECT CURDATE() as reportDate, 'daily' as reportType, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as totalSalesAmount, COUNT(*) as totalOrderCount, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) as discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(return_amount), 0) as returnAmount FROM sales_out WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 'approved'

SELECT CURDATE() as reportDate, 'daily' as reportType, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as totalPurchaseAmount, COUNT(*) as totalOrderCount, COALESCE(AVG(total_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount, COALESCE(SUM(return_amount), 0) as returnAmount FROM purchase_in WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = 'approved'

SELECT i.id, i.product_id as productId, p.product_name as productName, p.product_code as productCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, i.quantity, i.min_quantity as minQuantity, i.unit_price as unitPrice FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN product p ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE i.quantity <= i.min_quantity ORDER BY i.quantity ASC

SELECT i.id, i.product_id as productId, p.product_name as productName, p.product_code as productCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, i.quantity, i.unit_price as unitPrice, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(i.last_out_time, i.create_time)) as idleDays FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN product p ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON i.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE i.quantity > 0 AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(i.last_out_time, i.create_time)) >= #{days} ORDER BY idleDays DESC

SELECT CURDATE() as reportDate, 'summary' as reportType, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_income WHERE status = 'approved') as totalIncome, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM finance_expense WHERE status = 'approved') as totalExpense, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM finance_account WHERE status = 'active') as accountCount
